evidence.claim: Micron -5.3% in one day, -30% from high; hedge-fund crowded AI long, 'I don't own it, too dangerous'

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — How to Know if a Stock is Cheap or Expensive? Part 1 of 2 (2026-08-19)
evidence.claim: Micron's operating income and cash flow are highly cyclical, so its valuation is unreliable and the recent profit jump may not be sustainable; Khoo treats it as trade-only and not investable.
evidence.relation: If peak cyclical profits mean-revert, the current price embeds earnings that will not persist, so the downside risk is larger than the headline multiple suggests.

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — How to Pick Winning Stocks (The Simple Way) by Adam Khoo (2026-07-31)
evidence.claim: Micron's forward PE of 5.6 is an illusion from peak memory-cycle earnings; on the 5-year mean PE its value is about $556, making it roughly 57% overvalued.
evidence.relation: If memory undersupply ends and profits normalize, EPS falls and the PE re-expands toward about 30x, so the price falls even though the PE looks cheap.
